description: Mirror insert copies user_id from the source comment row onto the child comment
Mirror insert copies contact_id from the source comment row onto the child comment
Mirror insert copies author_type from the source comment row onto the child comment (no longer hard-coded 'unknown')
Mirror insert sets the child comment_threads.created_by to the source comment's user_id
Child copy keeps is_system_generated: true and remains immutable (updateComment/deleteComment still reject it)
Mirror path still writes the ticket_bundle_mirrors row and remains idempotent per (source_comment_id, child_ticket_id)
Mirror path publishes no TICKET_COMMENT_ADDED / comment publication for the child copy (only the master's event fires)
CommentItem renders the resolved author's name, email and avatar for is_system_generated comments when the author resolves
CommentItem renders a 'Bundled update' badge (tickets:conversation.bundledUpdate) next to the author name for is_system_generated comments
The 'Bundled update' badge is a link to /msp/tickets/{masterTicketId} when a bundleMaster prop is provided, and a plain badge otherwise
CommentItem falls back to today's rendering (label as name, placeholder avatar, no email) when is_system_generated and the author does not resolve
CommentItem, TicketConversation and BentoTimelineTile accept an optional bundleMaster { ticketId, ticketNumber } prop and pass it through
MSP TicketDetails supplies bundleMaster from bundle.masterTicket when the ticket is a bundle child
Client portal TicketDetails renders the badge without a link (no bundleMaster supplied)
Migration backfills user_id, contact_id and author_type on existing mirrored child comments from their source via ticket_bundle_mirrors
Migration backfills comment_threads.created_by for child thread roots from the source comment's user_id
Migration is idempotent (IS NULL guards) and Citus-safe (tenant co-located UPDATE ... FROM)
Migration down reverts only mirrored child rows reachable through ticket_bundle_mirrors back to null author / 'unknown'
Bundled-child email path is unchanged: child email addressed to the child's requester, entityId/replyContext on the child ticket, commentSource on the master comment, author name from the master
Audit: no reader infers 'mirrored comment' from user_id IS NULL; any such site uses is_system_generated or ticket_bundle_mirrors instead
Public comments API returns user_id / created_by_name / avatar for mirrored rows on a child ticket
If a badge tooltip string is introduced, it is added to every locale file under server/public/locales/*/features/tickets.json
